patthana16.89:1.1: rūpāvacaraṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na anidassana appaṭigho na rūpāvacaro dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, hetuyā cha.
patthana16.89:2.1: anidassana appaṭighaṃ na rūpāvacaraṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na sanidassana appaṭigho na na rūpāvacaro dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, hetuyā tīṇi. anidassana appaṭighaṃ
